objective: Establish whether browser-use can attach to T3 Code's built-in browser as its backend over the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
scope: T3 Code is github.com/pingdotgg/t3code (desktop app, Electron, and a web/server mode). From its repository source and docs, current as of 2026-11: 1. How is its browser or preview pane implemented (Electron webview, WebContentsView, BrowserView, an iframe in web mode)? 2. Does T3 Code expose a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint for that pane (Electron --remote-debugging-port, app.commandLine.appendSwitch('remote-debugging-port'), webContents.debugger, an env var or setting), or any MCP server or API through which an agent drives it (the preview tools HolyAgent uses in T3: how do they reach the pane)? 3. If a CDP endpoint can be enabled, would a CDP client attaching to it see only the preview page target or the whole app's renderer targets (app UI included), and what security implication that has. 4. browser-use 1.0.0 --cli-mcp attaches through BU_CDP_URL or BU_CDP_WS (see /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/browser-use-research.md): can it attach to an Electron CDP endpoint and pick one target (the preview page), and does it open new tabs or windows that an Electron webview cannot host?
Say clearly which parts are sourced (URL, file path in the t3code repo) and which are inference.
constraints: Make no edits and no git writes.

criteria.text: Each of the four questions is answered with a source or marked unknown
